HPLC_AIR_BUBBLE.cause: Improper mobile phase degassing allowing dissolved gases to form bubbles in the flow path
Incomplete system purging after solvent preparation or line changeover
Loose suction-side tubing or fitting allowing air ingress into the pump
Pump seal wear or check valve malfunction causing unstable solvent delivery

HPLC_BASELINE_FLUCTUATION.cause: Air trapped in the detector flow cell causing absorbance instability
Column not adequately equilibrated before assay sequence
Temperature-related solvent outgassing affecting baseline stability

HPLC_GENERAL.cause: Detector lamp instability affecting signal consistency
Incorrect mobile phase preparation impacting chromatographic performance

DEFAULT_GENERAL.cause: Deviation requires review of analyst execution against approved procedure
Deviation requires verification of equipment condition and maintenance status
Deviation requires review of method suitability and material condition
